CroPatella

2026

Interpretable sex estimation from an uploaded patellar STL using the centroid-size model selected for public deployment in the accompanying manuscript.

InputPatella STL with coordinates in millimetres
Method10,000 area-weighted surface points → deterministic 2,048-point sample → centroid size → logistic regression
OutputCentroid size + P(male) + sex classification + interactive 3D view
Associated manuscript

Before Complex 3D Learning, Consider Size: Centroid Size and PointNet-Based Sex Estimation from CT-Derived Patellar Models

Bubić V, Vidjak V, Perić I, Jurić Gunjača M, Dolić K, Bašić Ž, Jerković I · Manuscript under review

Open app ↗ Paper under review
Published

CroHyoIdea

2026

Upload a 3D hyoid model, place the required landmarks directly in the interface, and optionally enter fusion information for age-related interpretation.

Input3D hyoid model + in-app landmarking; optional fusion score
MethodThree-interlandmark-distance logistic sex model + fusion-based age interpretation
OutputProbabilistic sex estimate / class + fusion-based age interpretation
Associated paper

Analysis of hyoid bone variations to estimate sex, age, and morphology: A study on the Croatian population for forensic applications

Cundey R, Prieto Alcaide C, Jerković I, Barbir M, Holland MM, Bašić Ž · International Journal of Legal Medicine 140, 1613–1628

Open app ↗ View paper
Published

Mandible Classifier

2025

Automated sex estimation from an uploaded 3D mandibular model using point-cloud deep features followed by a conventional probabilistic classifier.

Input3D mandible STL
Method4,096-point cloud → adapted PointNet++ embedding → StandardScaler → logistic regression
OutputSex probability / class + 3D sampled point-cloud preview
Associated paper

Classifying Sex from MSCT-Derived 3D Mandibular Models Using an Adapted PointNet++ Deep Learning Approach in a Croatian Population

Shimkus E, Kružić I, Mladenović S, et al. · Journal of Imaging 11(10), 328

Open app ↗ View paper
Published

CroSterna

2025

Age estimation from sternal fusion and costal-cartilage ossification scores using the published combined prediction-classification model.

InputSternal fusion / rib-cartilage ossification scores + sex
MethodHybrid regression + classification; final model uses FM, FX, OR, OS and sex
OutputEstimated age with an adjusted 95% prediction interval
Associated paper

Age estimation through sternal fusion and costal cartilage ossification using MSCT in a Croatian population: model development and application

Vickov J, Jerković I, Perić I, Jerković N, Bašić Ž · International Journal of Legal Medicine 139, 715–728

Open app ↗ View paper
Published

CroCrania 2.0

2024

Sex estimation from standard cranial measurements or uploaded landmark data, bringing the published machine-learning workflow into a practical web interface.

InputLinear cranial measurements OR landmark file (.nts)
MethodLandmarks → interlandmark distances; tuned LR / LDA / SVM models with feature selection
OutputSex classification from the selected published ML model
Associated paper

Developing a fully applicable machine learning (ML) based sex classification model using linear cranial dimensions

Jerković I, Bašić Ž, Krešić E, et al. · Scientific Reports 14, 30969

Open app ↗ View paper
Published

CroWalker

2024

Population-specific sex estimation from Walker’s cranial morphological traits using Croatian logistic-regression standards.

InputNon-metric scores: nuchal crest, mastoid process, supraorbital edge and glabella
Method15 Croatian population-specific logistic-regression equations
OutputP(male), P(female) and final sex classification
Associated paper

Walker's traits for sex estimation in modern Croatian population using MSCT virtual cranial database: Validation and development of population-specific standards

Bareša T, Jerković I, Bašić Ž, et al. · Forensic Imaging 36, 200578
